title: OSM vector district: OpenFreeMap fallback and decoder
description: Browser/Node/Worker-ready bundled vector-tile adapter. Fetches a bounded OSM district from the OpenFreeMap TileJSON and up to nine z14 vector tiles, at most four parallel requests, then converts footprints/courtyard holes, road/water geometry and semantic POIs into Overpass-compatible JSON. Actual map data stays ODbL, with OpenFreeMap/OpenMapTiles/OSM attribution. Original adapter CC0, bundled maintained decoders BSD-3-Clause/ISC; no API token, imagery, map renderer or bare import required. Water-tower coverage is limited to retained local POIs rather than an 8km Overpass query.
author: the internet slop warehouse; Mapbox and Vladimir Agafonkin
